strategy_notes: DEFENSIVE MOMENTUM PHASE — Portfolio shifting from concentrated semis to selective positions with confirmed relative strength. Key rules: (1) Universal bearish MACD = maximum discipline. Take profits at +13-15% without hesitation. (2) Non-confirmers get 3-4 days max — if a position isn't up 3%+ from entry within that window during a momentum regime, it's a cut. (3) Relative strength on flat/down days remains the strongest entry signal — GOOGL today fits this perfectly. (4) Earnings season creates binary risk — reduce position sizes to 15% max and avoid adding to names reporting within 5 days unless you're willing to hold through. (5) Trailing stop implementation: for positions up 10%+, set mental stop at half the gain (e.g., +13% gain → stop at +6.5%). (6) Cash is a position — maintain 40%+ cash when all MACD signals are bearish. (7) Sector concentration max 2 names in same sector.
